explanation: The article states the line from the wartime alliance to the organisation: **"the Declaration by United Nations became the basis of the United Nations (UN), which was formalized in the UN Charter, signed by 50 countries on 26 June 1945."** It is the same name and the same signatories. The article notes that the allies invited Denmark, which had not signed, to the San Francisco conference of 1945, where they drew the Charter.
